findings.fix: A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: A section keeps its content on one side and leaves 758px of the width empty: "Ouvrez la carte de l'Afrique".
findings.fix: Fill the other side with what the section has (its picture, a second column, the figure), or defend the void in one sentence.
Set the title at display size, or make the large text of the first screen the h1.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 8 different lines (28px, 259px, 511px, 48px, 130px, 720px, 736px); the three most used hold only 55% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: 1 text block(s) sit 12–15px from the phone's edge: "Savane près de Kayes, Mali" (14px)
findings.fix: The page margin is 16–20px on a phone; the header and the corner labels sit on it too.
